locations.note: Wake Island, the game's signature map: Japan against the US Marines on the atoll.
The Battle of Midway map pits carriers and airfields against each other.
Guadalcanal, fought in the jungle around the airfield.
Iwo Jima, the landing on the black beaches under Mount Suribachi.
El Alamein, open desert tank warfare between Germany and Britain.
Tobruk, the besieged port's defensive lines.
The Battle of Gazala map in the Libyan desert.
Operation Battleaxe, the fight for the pass on the Egyptian border.
Omaha Beach, the D-Day landing from the sea.
Bocage, the hedgerow country of Normandy after the landings.
Operation Market Garden, the airborne fight for the Arnhem bridge.
Battle of the Bulge, the winter fighting in the Ardennes.
Stalingrad, street fighting in the ruined city.
Kharkov, the Eastern Front map around the city.
Battle of Kursk, the great tank clash on the steppe.
Battle of Berlin, the Red Army's final assault on the city.
Telemark, in the Secret Weapons of WWII expansion: a raid on the heavy-water plant in the snow.
Coral Sea: a carrier battle added with the first patch, fought from the flight decks.
Invasion of the Philippines: the Japanese landings of 1941, a map added by patch.
Liberation of Caen: the Normandy city in ruins, a map added by patch.
Battle of Britain: Spitfires against bombers over the English coast, a map added by patch.
Anzio: the beachhead south of Rome, in The Road to Rome expansion.
Monte Cassino: fighting up to the abbey, in The Road to Rome.
Salerno: the Allied landing of September 1943, in The Road to Rome.
Operation Husky: the invasion of Sicily, in The Road to Rome.
Operation Baytown and Monte Santa Croce: the Calabrian landing and the mountain road north, two Road to Rome maps.
Eagle's Nest: an assault on Hitler's mountain chalet, in Secret Weapons of WWII.
Essen: the Krupp works under attack, in Secret Weapons of WWII.
Gothic Line: the German line in the Apennines, in Secret Weapons of WWII.
Hellendoorn: the V-2 launch sites in the Dutch woods, in Secret Weapons of WWII.
Kbely Airfield: a raid on the Luftwaffe field outside Prague, in Secret Weapons of WWII.
Mimoyecques: the V-3 supergun bunker, in Secret Weapons of WWII.
Peenemünde: the rocket research centre on the Baltic, in Secret Weapons of WWII.
